fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional text description of the multicast domain activation.

fields.label: Disable Placement Policy
fields.help: Option to allow disabling placement policy for multicast infrastructure.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: Resource ID segment making up resource 'name'.

fields.label: Multicast Domain
fields.help: The resource name of the multicast domain to activate.

fields.label: Multicast Domain Activation ID
fields.help: A unique name for the multicast domain activation.

fields.label: Traffic Spec
Aggr Egress Pps
fields.help: Aggregated egress Packet-Per-Second for all multicast groups in the domain in this zone.

fields.label: Aggr Ingress Pps
fields.help: Aggregated ingress Packet-Per-Second for all multicast groups in the domain in this zone.

fields.label: Max Per Group Ingress Pps
fields.help: Maximum ingress Packet-Per-Second for a single multicast group in this zone.

fields.label: Max Per Group Subscribers
fields.help: Maximum number of subscribers for a single multicast group in this zone.
Specifies the traffic volume and multicast group scale parameters that are used to set up multicast infrastructure for a multicast domain in a zone.
